about: The Workbench icons of the RocksnDiamonds drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py icons/icons.json --out icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Rocks'n'Diamonds' own program icon (upstream graphics/gfx_classic/icons/icon.png at the pinned commit). The Installer's icon, which goes beside the drawer, is icons/installer.json's.
